The mark: a microscope slide, and the green dot is the specimen. Clearspace is twice the
dot's diameter. Below 22px wide, use the dot alone.

the underscore blinks, so the system reads as still being written. One instance per view.

Stacked sections that open one at a time to keep a long page scannable: settings groups,
FAQs, release notes. Each heading is a button with aria-expanded, and its panel is a
region labelled by it. Hairlines separate the rows; the open row shows a minus.

marked by aria-current and a 2px sample bar, badges for counts. It collapses to a rail of icons
that name themselves on hover and focus, and below md it becomes a Menu button that opens the
same navigation in a Drawer. A nav landmark; links are links and actions are buttons, so the
keyboard needs nothing beyond Tab.

components.name: AutoComplete
components.description:
Type-ahead search over local or remote data: customers, addresses, products. An ARIA
combobox with a listbox popup. Suggestions appear as the person types; Down opens the
list or moves the highlight, Up moves it back, Enter takes the highlighted option, and
Escape closes the list, or clears the text when the list is already closed. The match
is picked out in each suggestion, and the number of results is announced. With `search`,
calls are debounced, the previous call is aborted, and a spinner shows while it runs.

components.name: Avatar
components.description:
A round image or the initials of a person or workspace. It belongs to the dot family, so it
is the one fully round element besides the radio and the switch. The surface fill and
hairline keep initials legible in both themes; a status dot ringed in the canvas colour
shows presence.

components.name: AvatarGroup
components.description:
A row of overlapping avatars for the people on a record: assignees, reviewers, members.
Each avatar is ringed in the canvas colour so the overlap reads as a stack, and anyone past
max is counted in a final circle.

components.name: Badge
components.description:
A badge: a small count or flag that sits next to a nav item, a tab or an avatar. It is a
pill from the dot family, so it is fully round; with dot on it collapses to the dot alone.
Give it an aria-label whenever the number would be meaningless read on its own.

components.name: Banner
components.description:
A page-level announcement that runs edge to edge across the top of an app or a page: a
maintenance window, a trial that is ending, a new feature. It is about the whole product,
not one part of it. Use Message for a notice inside the content, next to what it is about,
and Toast for something that just happened and clears itself. A Banner stays put until its
cause goes away or the reader dismisses it.
Square, like the page frame it sits in: the tone's subtle fill with a hairline in the tone
colour under it, ink text over it (above 13:1 in both themes) and muted controls (above 4.8:1).

props.description: One or two sentences about the whole app or page, sentence case: "Scheduled maintenance on Sunday 12 October, 02:00 to 04:00 UTC."

props.name: tone
props.description: The status colour of the fill and the rule under it. danger is announced assertively; the rest politely.

props.name: action
props.description: One action that follows from the message: a link to the details or a small Button.

props.name: onDismiss
props.description: Shows a dismiss control. Leave it off for a banner that stays until its cause is fixed.

components.description:
Where the current page sits in the hierarchy, with a link back to each level above it.

components.name: Button
components.description:
A mono, hairline-bordered button with the mark's 4px corner. Structure comes from the border, so the
disabled state drops the fill and keeps the outline, and the danger variant is a
fill only because a destructive confirm has to look different from everything else.

props.description: The text on the button. Sentence case, starting with a verb: "Notify me", "Publish", "Delete".

props.name: variant
props.description: Which job the button does. One primary per view.

props.description: md for forms and page actions, sm for table rows and toolbars.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Inert. Every variant collapses to the same outlined, muted form so a disabled control reads the same everywhere.

components.name: ButtonGroup
components.description:
Related actions joined into one shape: "Day, Week, Month" view buttons, "Previous, Next", or
alignment in an editor toolbar. The buttons stay ordinary Buttons and IconButtons, each in the
tab order; the group names them with role="group" and joins their borders. For actions that
only need to sit together, a row with a gap is enough. Use SelectButton when exactly one
option is on at a time, and SplitButton for one main action with a few related ones in a menu.

props.name: label
props.description: Names the group for assistive technology: "Calendar view", "Text alignment". Sentence case.

props.name: children
props.description: The Buttons and IconButtons in the group, in reading order. Give them one variant and one size.

props.name: orientation
props.description: horizontal in toolbars and page headers, vertical in a narrow side panel.

components.name: Card
components.description:
A framed panel that groups one subject on a screen: a plan, a setting, a summary. Flat
like every panel in the system: surface fill, hairline edge, the 8px panel corner. Title
and description are optional, so a card can also frame a bare table or chart. Set
`headingLevel` to match where the card sits in the page outline, and `titleSize` to lg
when the title is a figure.

props.description: The card's heading. Sentence case.

components.name: Checkbox
components.description:
A box with the mark's 4px corner, hairline border, green fill with an ink tick when on. The native input
is drawn with appearance:none so it keeps keyboard, focus ring and form semantics while
matching the Figma component pixel for pixel. Never pre-tick a consent box.

It holds its own state, seeded from `checked`, and follows `checked` whenever the prop
changes, so a parent can tick or clear a group at once. Pass `onChange` to hear each change.

components.name: ConfirmDialog
components.description:
The confirm step before a destructive or important action, built on Dialog. Focus lands on
the cancel button when it opens, so a reflexive Enter backs out rather than going ahead. The
confirm button names the action, and the danger tone turns it into the red fill. While the
action runs, pending holds the dialog open with both buttons inert and a spinner beside them.
For an action that cannot be undone and takes a lot with it (deleting a workspace), pass
confirmText: confirm stays locked until the reader types it exactly.

components.description:
A menu of actions on whatever is under the pointer: right-click, a long press on touch, or
Shift F10 and the context menu key when the area has focus. It opens at the pointer, inside
the viewport, with focus on the first item. Up and Down move, Home and End jump, typing a
letter jumps to the next item starting with it, Enter or Space runs the item, Escape and Tab
close it and return focus to the area.

components.name: DataTable
components.description:
A data grid for large record sets: sort, filter, select, resize, page and scroll through
ten thousand rows without rendering them all. Exposed as an ARIA grid with one tab stop:
arrow keys move between cells, Home and End go to the ends of a row, Ctrl+Home and
Ctrl+End to the first and last cell, Page Up and Page Down by a screenful. On a header,
Enter sorts (ascending, descending, off) and Shift with the left or right arrow resizes
the column; columns also resize by dragging their right edge. With `selectable`, Space
selects the focused row. Flat like Table: hairlines between rows, line-strong under the
header, no zebra stripes, numbers aligned to the end with tabular figures.

components.name: DatePicker

a button drawn like Field; it opens a non-modal dialog holding a month grid. In the grid,

day, and Escape closes and returns focus to the field. In range mode the first pick sets
the start and the second the end; the days between fill in as you move. Month and
weekday names, and the displayed format, come from Intl in the given locale.

components.name: Dialog

A modal for a decision that blocks everything else. Built on the native dialog element,
so focus is trapped, the page behind is inert, and Escape closes it without extra code.
Flat, per brand section 06: the page dims behind the scrim token, and the panel
separates with surface fill and a line-strong edge. Actions go in `footer`, so they sit in
the same place on every dialog: under a hairline, aligned to the end, the primary last.

Actions go in `footer`, which stays pinned to the foot of the sheet while the body scrolls.

components.name: Fieldset
components.description:
A titled group of related form fields: a native fieldset and legend, so assistive technology
announces the legend when focus enters the group, and disabled reaches every control inside
without each one being told. The legend is a sentence-case title rather than a capitalised
field label, so it reads as a level above the labels it holds. Legend and description keep
their colours when the group is disabled: the controls show the state, the title stays legible.

components.name: IconButton
components.description:

toolbar: edit, copy, more, close. The label is required, because it is the button's only
name, and doubles as the native tooltip. Same variants, colours and disabled outline as
Button. Pass `pressed` to make it a toggle; it then reports its state with aria-pressed.

hairline and are named in aria-describedby, so "£" is read with the price. The icon sits
inside the input's cell and is decorative; the label says what the field is for.

of it: the columns to export, the regions a report covers. One tab stop; arrow keys move,

or Enter selects. With one choice, moving also selects, as a radio group does. With multiple,
moving only moves, Space toggles, and Ctrl or Command with A selects every option. Use Select when the list can hide until it is needed.

components.name: MegaMenu
components.description:
A menu bar whose entries open wide panels of grouped links, for products with more pages than
a navbar can hold. Built on the WAI-ARIA menubar pattern. In the bar, Left and Right move between
entries, Down, Enter or Space opens one and focuses its first link, Home and End jump. In a
panel, Up and Down move through the links, Left and Right move between columns and then on to
the neighbouring entry, Escape closes it and returns focus to the bar, Tab closes it and moves on.
Panels also open on click; a click outside closes them.

item; arrow keys move, Home and End jump, Enter or Space runs the item and closes the
menu, Escape closes it and returns focus to the trigger, Tab closes it and moves on.

props.description: Shows the current value at the right of the label row.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Inert. Track and thumb go to the disabled colour.

components.name: Spinner
components.description:
A wait of unknown length, too short for a ProgressBar. A ring in the line colour with a
sample-green arc that turns. Under reduced motion it stops turning and stays visible, so
the loading state is still clear.

props.name: label
props.description: What is loading, for assistive technology: "Loading invoices". Not shown.

props.name: size
props.description: sm sits inline with text or inside a Button; md stands alone in an empty region.

components.name: SplitButton
components.description:
A main action joined to an arrow that opens the actions next to it, for a button with one
common job and a few less common ones: "Send invoice" with "Send a test", "Schedule" and
"Download PDF". The left half is a Button and the right half opens a Menu, so the colours,
keyboard handling and popover come from those two. On primary an ink rule divides the
halves; on secondary they share one border.

props.name: label
props.description: The main action, on the left. Sentence case, starting with a verb: "Send invoice", "Publish".

props.name: items
props.description: The other actions, in the menu the arrow opens. Content, not a Figma property: the library shows three.

props.name: variant
props.description: primary when the main action is the one green action in the view, secondary otherwise.

props.name: size
props.description: md for forms and page actions, sm for table rows and toolbars.

props.name: menuLabel
props.description: Names the arrow for assistive technology, since it shows no text.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Inert. Both halves collapse to the disabled outline, as Button does.

props.name: onClick
props.description: Runs the main action.

components.name: Splitter
components.description:
Two resizable panes for an editor and its inspector, or a list and its detail. The divider
is a focusable separator carrying its position in aria-valuenow: Left and Right (Up and Down
when stacked) move it, Home and End jump to the limits, Enter collapses the first pane to its
minimum and restores it. Dragging uses pointer capture, so it works with a mouse, pen or finger.

props.name: orientation
props.description: horizontal puts the panes side by side; vertical stacks them.

props.name: start
props.description: The first pane: left, or top.

props.name: end
props.description: The second pane: right, or bottom.

props.name: label
props.description: Names the divider for screen readers, after the pane it resizes: "Resize file list".

props.name: defaultSize
props.description: Size of the first pane at first render, as a percentage of the whole.

props.name: min
props.description: Smallest the first pane can get, as a percentage.

props.name: max
props.description: Largest the first pane can get, as a percentage.

props.name: step
props.description: How far one arrow key press moves the divider, as a percentage.

props.name: onResize
props.description: Called with the new size of the first pane, as a percentage, after every change.

props.name: height
props.description: Height of the whole splitter in pixels. Panes scroll inside it.

components.name: Stat
components.description:
A key figure with its label, and how it moved since the last period. The arrow shows the
direction; the colour says whether that is good, which depends on the figure: revenue up
is success, overdue invoices up is danger. The direction is also spoken, so it never rests
on the arrow or the colour alone. Built as a description list (label, figure, caption), so
a row of Stats reads as a set of named values.

props.name: label
props.description: What the figure measures, sentence case: "Monthly recurring revenue".

props.name: value
props.description: The figure, formatted: "£84,210", "112%", "9 days".

props.name: change
props.description: How far the figure moved against the previous period: "3.6%", "£1,240", "3 days".

props.name: direction
props.description: Which way it moved. Draws the arrow and, with goodDirection, picks the colour. flat is muted.

props.name: goodDirection
props.description: Which way is good news. up for revenue, down for churn, overdue invoices or time to reply.

props.name: caption
props.description: One line naming the comparison or the context: "Against September", "6 invoices, up from 4 last week".

props.name: size
props.description: md in a row of figures, lg for the one figure a screen leads with.

props.name: variant
props.description: card frames the figure on its own; plain leaves the frame to a parent, such as a strip of figures sharing hairlines.

args.label: Collected in October
args.caption: 26% of the month invoiced so far

components.name: Stepper
components.description:
Shows where someone is in a multi-step flow: which steps are done, which one they are on,
and what is left. State never rests on colour alone: a complete step shows a tick, the
current step a filled dot and aria-current="step", and each item carries its state as
visually hidden text.

props.name: steps
props.description: The steps, in order. Content, not a Figma property: the library shows four.

props.name: current
props.description: The index of the current step, counting from 0. Earlier steps are complete.

props.name: orientation
props.description: horizontal across the top of a form, vertical beside a longer flow.

components.name: Switch
components.description:
A setting that takes effect immediately. Use Checkbox instead when the choice is
submitted with a form. A native checkbox with role="switch", drawn as a pill whose thumb
is the specimen dot: the line is an inset ring so the 8px dot sits exactly 4px from every
edge and travels one spacing step (lg, 16px).

It holds its own state, seeded from `checked`, and follows `checked` whenever the prop
changes, so a parent can turn a group off at once (a "pause all" switch). Pass `onChange`
to hear every flip. With `labelVisible` off, the label is read out but not drawn, for a
grid of switches whose row and column already say what each one does.

props.name: label
props.description: What turns on. Name the setting, not the action: "publish on save", not "enable".

props.name: description
props.description: One line under the label, in faint.

props.name: checked
props.description: Whether it is on. Follows the prop when it changes, so a parent can drive it; a click flips it either way.

props.name: labelVisible
props.description: Show the label beside the switch. Off hides it visually; it stays the accessible name.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Inert. Track, thumb and text go to the disabled colour.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called with the new state whenever a person flips it.

components.name: Table
components.description:
A plain data table. Rows separate with decorative hairlines (line), the header with
line-strong; no zebra stripes and no cell borders, so structure comes from lines as the
brand asks. Numbers align to the end with tabular figures.

props.name: columns
props.description: Column definitions, in order. Content, not a Figma property.

props.name: rows
props.description: One record per row, keyed by column key. Content, not a Figma property.

props.name: caption
props.description: Says what the table holds. Above the table, in the caption style.

props.name: density
props.description: compact for admin lists and anything scanned rather than read. Decided 10 Sep 2026: a prop on Table, not a global mode.

args.caption: Colour roles on canvas, dark theme
Colour roles on canvas, dark theme

components.name: Tabs
components.description:
Sections of one view that are read one at a time. The selected tab carries a 2px
sample bar on the shared hairline, the same device as the section headers. Arrow keys
move between tabs and select as they go; Home and End jump to either end. Give the set
a name with aria-label.

props.name: items
props.description: The tabs and their panels. Content, not a Figma property: the library shows three.

items.label: Usage
items.content: One primary button per view. Sentence case, starting with a verb.

items.label: Props
items.content: Four props: variant, size, disabled and label.

items.label: Tokens
items.content: Reads sample-fill, on-sample, line-interactive and disabled.

components.name: Tag
components.description:
The tag: 1px stroke, no fill, small caps, wide tracking. Metadata only, never a
headline. It is a label, so it carries no hover and no focus.

props.name: label
props.description: Catalogue text: "SPC-014 · BUTTON · STABLE". Rendered uppercase. Use middle dots to separate.

props.name: tone
props.description: Colour of stroke and text. sample for catalogue labels, muted for inert metadata, the four status tones for state.

components.name: Textarea
components.description:
Field for more than one line: same label, hint and error slots, same border rules.
Four rows by default and resizable vertically only, so a long answer can grow without
breaking the column it sits in.

props.name: label
props.description: Always visible, above the box. Uppercase label style.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Shown inside the empty box, in faint.

props.name: hint
props.description: One line under the box. Hidden while an error is showing.

props.name: error
props.description: Replaces the hint, turns the border danger, and is announced as an alert.

props.name: required
props.description: Adds the green asterisk and the native required attribute.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Inert. Border and text go to the disabled colour; no fill.

props.name: readOnly
props.description: Displayed, not editable. Loses the interactive border, since there is nothing to find and click.

args.label: Release notes
args.hint: Markdown is rendered on the changelog page.

args.label: Release notes
args.error: A release needs at least one line of notes.

args.label: Published notes
args.defaultValue: Button gains a danger variant. Field reads its border from line-interactive.

args.label: Release notes
args.placeholder: Locked while the release is building

components.name: TimePicker
components.description:
A time field with a list of times, for meetings, bookings and opening hours. The control is a
button drawn like Field; it opens a listbox of times every `step` minutes between `min` and
`max`. In the list, the arrow keys move one time, Page Up and Page Down move an hour, Home and
End go to the first and last time, typing digits jumps to the first time that starts with
them, Enter picks, and Escape closes and returns focus to the field. The value is always
24-hour "HH:MM", whichever format is shown, so it submits and stores the same everywhere.

props.name: label
props.description: Always visible, above the control. Uppercase label style.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The time on first render, as 24-hour "HH:MM": "09:30". Uncontrolled; pass onChange to observe it.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called with the chosen time as "HH:MM", or null when cleared.

props.name: step
props.description: Minutes between the times in the list. 15 for meetings, 30 for bookings, 5 for fine control.

props.name: min
props.description: The earliest time in the list, as "HH:MM".

props.name: max
props.description: The latest time in the list, as "HH:MM".

props.name: format
props.description: 24h shows 14:30; 12h shows 2:30 pm. The submitted value is always 24-hour.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Shown in the empty control, in muted.

props.name: hint
props.description: One line under the control. Hidden while an error is showing.

props.name: error
props.description: Replaces the hint, turns the border danger, and is announced as an alert.

props.name: required
props.description: Adds the green asterisk.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Inert. Border and text go to the disabled colour.

props.name: name
props.description: Submits the value with a form as "HH:MM".

args.label: Start time
args.hint: Shown in your time zone, London.

args.label: Booking slot
args.hint: Bookings from 8:00 to 18:00.

args.label: End time
args.error: Choose an end time after the start time.

args.label: Start time
args.hint: Set by the meeting room.

components.name: Timeline
components.description:
A vertical list of events: account activity, an audit trail, the history of an invoice.
Each event is a dot on a hairline rule, its time in mono above the title, and an optional
line of detail in Archivo. A muted event draws a hollow dot; the status tones fill it. The
colour only reinforces the title, so a failed payment still says "failed" in words.

props.name: items
props.description: The events, newest first for activity and audit logs. Content, not a Figma property: the library shows four.

props.name: label
props.description: Names the list for assistive technology when no heading sits above it: "Account activity".

items.title: Ruth Calder changed the billing contact
Ruth Calder signed in from Leeds

components.name: Toast
components.description:
A short notice about something that just happened. Flat: surface fill, line-strong
edge, and the status colour as a 4px bar on the left edge,
so four tones never turn a screen into a traffic light. Put toasts in a ToastRegion.

props.name: title
props.description: What happened, past tense, sentence case: "Token copied", "Release published".

props.name: description
props.description: One line of detail or the next step.

props.name: tone
props.description: The status colour of the bar. danger is announced assertively; the rest politely.

props.name: onDismiss
props.description: Shows a close control. Leave it off for a toast that clears itself.

args.title: Token copied
args.description: --color-sample-fill is on the clipboard.

args.title: Release published
args.description: v0.1.0 is live on npm.

args.title: Figma check skipped
args.description: The API did not answer. The next scheduled run will retry.

args.title: Drift found
args.description: Button.size has different values in Figma and in code.

components.name: Toolbar
components.description:
A row of related controls above a table or an editor, with an end group pinned to the
right. Exposed as role="toolbar"; Left and Right arrows move focus between its controls,
Home and End jump to either end, and Tab leaves the toolbar as usual.

props.name: children
props.description: Controls on the left: filters, view switches, bulk actions.

props.name: end
props.description: Controls pinned to the right: export, create, settings.

components.name: Tooltip
components.description:
A label that appears on hover and on keyboard focus, and goes on Escape or when either
ends. Flat like every overlay in the system: surface fill, line-strong edge, no shadow.
The trigger is described by it, so a screen reader hears the label after the name.

props.name: label
props.description: One short line. A tooltip names or explains; it never holds anything the user must read to proceed.

props.name: side
props.description: Which side of the trigger it opens on.

props.name: children
props.description: The trigger: one focusable element, usually an icon-only button.

components.name: Tree
components.description:
A hierarchy a person can open, select and reorder: folders, accounts, a chart of
accounts, permissions. ARIA tree with one tab stop. Up and Down move through the visible
items; Right opens an item or moves to its first child; Left closes it or moves to its
parent; Home and End jump; typing a letter moves to the next item starting with it;
Enter or Space selects. In multiple selection a parent's box ticks its whole branch and
shows a dash when only part of it is selected. With `reorderable`, drag a row onto the
top or bottom half of another to place it before or after, or press Alt with the up or
down arrow to move it among its siblings.

props.name: label
props.description: The tree's accessible name: "Workspace folders". Not drawn; put a visible heading beside it.

props.name: nodes
props.description: The hierarchy. Uncontrolled: reordering updates an internal copy and reports it.

props.name: selection
props.description: none for navigation only, single to pick one item, multiple for checkboxes.

props.name: defaultExpanded
props.description: Ids open on first render.

props.name: defaultSelected
props.description: Ids selected on first render.

props.name: onSelectionChange
props.description: Called with every selected id after each change.

props.name: reorderable
props.description: Lets items move by drag, or by Alt with the up or down arrow.

props.name: onReorder
props.description: Called with the whole tree after a move.

components.name: TreeSelect
components.description:
Choose one item from a hierarchy without leaving the form: a team inside a department, a
folder inside a project. The field is a combobox button that opens a tree below it. In the
tree, Up and Down move, Right opens a branch or steps into it, Left closes it or steps out
to its parent, Home and End jump, typing a letter jumps to the next item starting with it,
Enter or Space chooses, and Escape closes and returns to the field. The tree follows the
APG tree view pattern: role tree, treeitem with aria-level, aria-expanded and
aria-selected, and one tab stop.

props.name: label
props.description: Always visible, above the control. Uppercase label style.

props.name: hint
props.description: One line under the control. Hidden while an error is showing.

props.name: error
props.description: Replaces the hint, turns the border danger, and is announced as an alert.

props.name: required
props.description: Adds the green asterisk and marks the control required.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Inert. Border and text go to the disabled colour; no fill.

props.name: nodes
props.description: The hierarchy. Content, not a Figma property.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The id chosen at first, for an uncontrolled field.

props.name: selectable
props.description: leaf allows only items without children; any lets a branch be chosen too.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Shown in the field while nothing is chosen.

props.name: showPath
props.description: Shows the full path ("Engineering / Platform / Payments") in the field instead of the label.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called with the chosen node's id.

props.name: name
props.description: Submitted with a form under this name, as the chosen id.
